**Nissan Silvia S15 for Midnight Club 3: DUB Edition Remix**

The Nissan Silvia S15 converted to Midnight Club 3 (PS2). It replaces the **Sports Concept** (vp\_d\_sportconcept\_05) in-game.

**Features**

- Customizable parts in the Visual Shop: bumpers, side skirts, hoods, spoilers and tail lights
- Working headlights, tail lights, brake and reverse lights
- Garage, player and opponent versions of the car
- 10 opponent variations with randomized parts
- Optional Mona Lisa vinyl and HD light/badge textures (PCSX2 Texture Replacement)


**Important:** MC3 Modding Toolkit installs the mod straight into the ISO and overwrites the opened file. **Make a backup copy of your ISO before installing.** There is no undo.

**Requirements**

- [MC3 Modding Toolkit](https://github.com/vitorlk0/MC3-Modding-Toolkit/releases/latest) (free)
- [PCSX2](https://pcsx2.net/) (to play and to use the HD textures)


**Installation (ISO)**

- Open MC3 Modding Toolkit.
- If your ISO is still the original one, create a compacted ISO with the **Compact ISO** tool: drop the ISO and click Compact. It creates a copy with free space for mods.
- Close PCSX2 (or at least close the ISO in it). While the ISO is open in the emulator, the install is not written.
- Go to the **ISO Install** tab.
- In "Open the ISO", open your compacted ISO.
- In "Add car mods", click **\+ ADD ZIP** and select the downloaded ZIP (no need to extract it). It will detect: Garage, Vehicle DAT, Flash menus and Carcfg 10/10.
- Check the Install plan and click **Install**.
- Open the ISO in PCSX2 and look for the Sports Concept at the dealership.


**HD textures and Mona Lisa vinyl (optional, PCSX2 only)**

- Copy the .png files from the **Textures** folder to: _Documents\\PCSX2\\textures\\SLUS-21355\\replacements_
- In PCSX2, enable **Settings > Graphics > Texture Replacement > Load Textures**.
- The Mona Lisa vinyl replaces the **Rockstar Flag #1** vinyl. To use it, apply Rockstar Flag #1 in the Detail Shop.


**Using HostFS (unpacked game)**

- Extract vp\_d\_sportconcept\_05.dat inside the MC3HostFS\\ASSETS folder (it already holds the resources\\vehicle\\vp\_d\_sportconcept\_05 path).
- Copy the flash, resources and tune folders from the ZIP into MC3HostFS\\ASSETS, replacing the files.


**How it was made**

I recorded the full conversion process, from the OBJ model to the compiled ISO:

- [Video tutorial](https://youtu.be/47ZBK2PJeWU) (PT-BR)
- [Written version of the process](https://mc3-obj-tutorial.vercel.app/en/) (English)
- [Blender base file](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1BrPDvsXUZ4fIEHgk7BQ0eyAuP4AW4-jb/view?usp=sharing) I use as a starting point for car mods


**Credits**

- Model converted by Victor Oliveira ( [MidEngine](https://www.youtube.com/@mid_engine))
- Mona Lisa vinyl art: VICTOSOUZA762 ( [seeklogo](https://seeklogo.com/vector-logo/429883/mona-lisa-s15-dos-velozes-e-furiosos-tokyo-drift))
- DAVE (.dat) format: [dave.py](https://ednessp.github.io/tools#Midnight_Club), by Edness",
